method: Each budget was written by hand with planted mistakes. Expected verdicts come from the USG Funding Department Guidelines (current as of October 21, 2026) and, for the 4-events limit, the USG web page; sums and per-person figures are plain arithmetic on the listed whole-cent amounts. Unverified rules give yellow.
